crawl: Chrome live crawl, same-origin fetch, cache: no-store, sequential per URL, on 2026-10-09 Vietnam time (one-day step from 8 Oct). Words, schema and status were re-measured in a second pass later the same day; internal links were measured in the first pass (2,711) and re-read in that second pass (2,805).
method: TTFB measured with performance.now() around a sequential fetch of each URL with a 15 s abort. Words counted on a body clone with script/style/noscript/template removed. Schema blocks counted as application/ld+json elements, @type walked through @graph. Internal links are unique same-origin paths per page. MISSING-ALT RULE (in force since 2 Oct 2026): only visible outside
score_rationale: Health 97 -> 97 (raw 96.9 -> 96.65; weights .25/.25/.20/.15/.15). One-day step from 8 Oct. Only CRAWLABILITY moves, 99 -> 98: in the first crawl the site-wide promoted template link is GONE AGAIN (2,805 -> 2,711 distinct internal links, 23.8 -> 23.0 per page, -1 on each of 94 articles; /articles/bim-3d-from-design-to-site-in-2026 stays at 22; the link target is inferred, not measured). A second full read of 120 URLs later the same day returned 2,805 again, so the link flaps within a day; the record keeps the first crawl as the day's measurement and notes the re-read. All 118 pages still return 200, zero orphans, zero hub-only articles, the /articles overlay still gone. PERFORMANCE 98 (TTFB mean 327.0 ms, median 270 ms, ceiling 580 ms on /about, all 118 pages under 1 s; the mean is 19 ms higher than 8 Oct but the band is unchanged so the score holds on judgement). STRUCTURED DATA 98 (116/118 pages with schema, FAQPage 95/95 articles, 407 JSON-LD blocks). ON-PAGE 94 (118/118 one H1, title, meta description, self canonical; 0 images missing alt under the visible- rule). CONTENT 93 (corpus 241,675 words unchanged, still no new article since 24 Sep, 15 days). Ahrefs Site Audit results are reported separately in ahrefs_site_audit and do not feed this score.
